{{quote|Truly, this is a stunning victory that all Republic citizens can feel proud of!|General Vander|<ref name="Mail Altair" />}}

During the [[Galactic War]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vander]] led a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] force to the planet of [[Altair 9]] in order to liberate the world. Following a ten-month long siege of the planets capital, [[Klemark]], the world was finally freed from [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] control through the help of the [[Republic Special Forces Division|SpecForce unit]] [[Eclipse Squad]], who infiltrated the city and deactivated its defenses.<ref name="Mail Altair" />

==Aftermath==
In the wake of the battle, all Imperial defenders were either killed or captured and food, as well as other aid, was subsequently provided to the long-suffering populace of Altair 9. General Vander would later speak to a small collection of journalists in the hours following this victory, saying "truly, this is a stunning victory that all Republic citizens can feel proud of!"<ref name="Mail Altair" />

The hard fought victory would however not last long, as the SpecForce [[Squad/Legends|Squad]], which brought about the sudden victory, soon went unstable. A fight at [[Fort Klemark]] broke out and 200 Republic soldiers died as a result, after which Eclipse Squad disappeared.<ref name="TOR Eclipse" />
